title: ‘Sophisticated’ and ‘serious’ cyberattack of 1984 Hosting may be part of a $13.5 million crypto heist.
summary: The “free speech” provider announced it was temporarily shutting down services on Friday following the incident. Crypto exchange Wagyu blamed 1984 for a hack that saw $13.5 million in tokens drained from the site.
